idea-plugin.name: Inline Reading Mode
idea-plugin.description: Read code without jumping between files: put the caret on a method call and press Alt+, to show the callee's body inline below the call — read-only, syntax-highlighted, recursive (expand calls inside the expanded body too). Press the shortcut again, Esc, or click the header to collapse.

action.description: Show the called method's body inline below the call, read-only

action.text: Toggle Focus on Symbol at Caret
action.description: Track the parameter or local variable at the caret: every line touching it gets highlighted
Search and manage tracked symbols: parameters, locals, and fields of the current method
Collapse every line that doesn't touch a focused symbol into an expandable '⋯ N lines' region
Follow value flow: highlight not just the tracked symbols but everything derived from them and everything that writes into them
